name: model-ladder
description: Run a coding task on the cheapest model and effort likely to succeed, verify it, and escalate on failure.

autoRun.title: Use the ladder by default
autoRun.description: At the start of each session, tell Claude that top-level coding tasks in a git repository go through /model-ladder:run unless you say to skip it. Off: the ladder runs only when you call it.

band.title: Show the band
band.description: Show the model-ladder band above the prompt: subscription usage, the ladder agents running now, and the usage guard switch. Off hides it; the usage guard keeps working.

worker_skills.title: Worker skill instructions
worker_skills.description: Natural-language instructions for workers and test-writers; they may name skills, plugins or MCP servers. Example: When coding, use ponytail to review and simplify the code; when working on UI, use available UI/UX skills. Applies to every project by default; a project overrides it with the same key, worker_skills, in .claude/model-ladder.json. Empty = none.

verifier_skills.title: Verifier skill instructions
verifier_skills.description: Natural-language instructions for the verifier; they may name skills, plugins or MCP servers. Example: When reviewing code, use ponytail to spot simplifications. The verifier only checks and never fixes code. Applies to every project by default; a project overrides it with the same key, verifier_skills, in .claude/model-ladder.json. Empty = none.

direct_threshold.title: Direct threshold (% of context window)
direct_threshold.description: The current session's context as a percentage of its context window. When it is at or above this and the task is small, this session does the task directly instead of running the ladder. off = never direct. A project overrides it with the same key, direct_threshold, in .claude/model-ladder.json.

split_minutes.title: Split suggestion (minutes)
split_minutes.description: When the router estimates a task will take longer than this many minutes, the ladder asks whether to run it in parts, run it whole, or stop. off = never suggest a split. A project overrides it with the same key, split_minutes, in .claude/model-ladder.json.
